record_usage:
(defn record_usage [key model tokens]
  (when-not (and (string? key) (not (blank? key)))
    (throw (ex-info "key must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? model) (not (blank? model)))
    (throw (ex-info "model must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (number? tokens) (pos? tokens) (== tokens (round tokens)))
    (throw (ex-info "tokens must be a positive whole number" {})))
  (let [quota (get-in (state) ["quotas" key])]
    (when (and (number? quota) (> (+ (usage key) tokens) quota))
      (throw (ex-info "quota exceeded" {}))))
  (swap-state! update "calls" (fnil conj [])
               {"key" key "model" model "tokens" tokens})
  (usage key))
set_price:
(defn set_price [model cents_per_1k_tokens]
  (when-not (string? model)
    (throw (ex-info "model must be a string" {})))
  (when-not (and (number? cents_per_1k_tokens) (not (neg? cents_per_1k_tokens)))
    (throw (ex-info "price must be a non-negative number" {})))
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["prices" model] cents_per_1k_tokens)
  cents_per_1k_tokens)
cost:
(defn cost [key]
  (let [prices (get (state) "prices" {})
        dollars (reduce + 0
                        (map (fn [c]
                               (let [p (get prices (get c "model"))]
                                 (if (number? p)
                                   (/ (* (get c "tokens") p) 100000)
                                   0)))
                             (filter (fn [c] (= (get c "key") key))
                                     (get (state) "calls" []))))]
    (/ (round (* dollars 100)) 100)))
set_quota:
(defn set_quota [key tokens]
  (when-not (string? key)
    (throw (ex-info "key must be a string" {})))
  (when-not (and (number? tokens) (not (neg? tokens)))
    (throw (ex-info "quota must be a non-negative number" {})))
  (when (> (usage key) tokens)
    (throw (ex-info "quota is below tokens already used" {})))
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["quotas" key] tokens)
  tokens)
